meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调查你报的 bug:拉取最新 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码,判断该由哪个仓库负责,再产出英文 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可能出 PR),含复现步骤、根因与修复建议,并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签和页脚。
howto.when: 当你要求上报、提交或分流 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug,或需要带源码依据的根因与归属判断时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报一个 bug,附上复现步骤和根因
say.note: 它会先查源码、定仓库,再建 issue

say.text: Codex CLI 上游崩溃的 bug,帮我提到 openai/codex
say.note: 只有该仓库才可能建 PR

say.text: 先搜搜目标仓库有没有相同的 bug,有就补充证据评论

howto.what_en: Claude investigates the bug, pulls the latest LazyCodex and Codex sources, decides which repo owns it, and files an English GitHub issue (or, only for openai/codex, a PR) with repro steps, root cause and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, or need source-backed root cause and routing.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex bug with repro steps and root cause
say_en.note: It checks sources and picks the repo first

say_en.text: File this Codex CLI crash in openai/codex
say_en.note: Only that repo can get a PR

say_en.text: Search the target repo for a duplicate bug first
say_en.note: An existing issue gets a comment instead
